responsibility: This machine description adds microMIPS-specific instruction patterns and peephole optimizations that are not part of the base MIPS ISA description. It recognizes multi-register save/restore forms, load/store pair instructions, MOVEP register-pair moves, and the JRADDIUSP return form, using helper predicates and output routines from the backend to compress ordinary RTL sequences into microMIPS encodings and to mark forms that cannot safely appear in delay slots.
